name: Ikura Karen
source:
The older of the Ikura sisters.
A girl who exudes a cool and mysterious aura.
She speaks little and in a detached manner, often making her stand out from those around her. Usually it's very difficult to understand what she's thinking, however, once the topic shifts to something she "likes"…?
Although her younger sister seems more responsible, she surprisingly has a family-oriented and domestic side.
Despite her pure appearance, she harbors an intense sex drive. She is a closet pervert whose lewd thoughts are shown clearly on her face.
She made her cosplay debut after being encouraged by her younger sister. Through role-playing with the protagonist, she begins to enjoy not just wearing the costumes but fully embodying the characters.
Whether it’s cosplay, role-playing, or her work, she strives relentlessly to reach new heights.

"Right... Let’s do more lewd role-playing..."
